instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep how this device of mine stands: caught up, offline or still holding changes", and give it device_id; state; request_key (Names this change, so sending it again changes nothing twice).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:say-how-this-device-stands and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Keeps one device's report in your device rows (setting:catch_up_devices): device_id (the id the device keeps for itself), state, waiting (the changes it still holds), at (when its writes last reached your store), title, kind and copy_id (the copy of your records it keeps).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: setting (records:read, records:write).
